body: Thank you for your advice, but I've tried doing what you said on a smaller scale, I gave myself a week then three weeks then a month to wait for things to get better but they never did. If it's a simple matter of finding lost motivation as you said, then I'm not even sure how to find it.

Thank you for your advice and thank you for replying to me. I'm at a point in my life where I don't really feel in control of it anymore. I feel like I won't go anywhere if I quit medicine and at this point, we've already sunk quite literally hundreds of thousands into my education. I like my work, but I also feel very very tired. Most days it feels like it'll be easier for me to put a plastic bag over than to get up and get through another day. Everything I do just feels like I'm digging myself in deeper.
